action.summary: Count negative Late Flight tweets for US Airways
action.command:
cd /home/user/input && python3 -c "
import pandas as pd
df = pd.read_csv('Tweets.csv')

# Filter for US Airways, negative sentiment, Late Flight reason
usairways_lateflight_negative = df[
    (df['airline'] == 'US Airways') & 
    (df['airline_sentiment'] == 'negative') & 
    (df['negativereason'] == 'Late Flight')
]

print('Count of negative tweets attributed to Late Flight for US Airways:', len(usairways_lateflight_negative))
"
